issues: The implementation of `syncCategoriesWithReceipts` adds any receipt category not present in the default list as a custom category, which can cause a duplicate entry when a default category is renamed (the new name appears both in the renamed default mapping and as a custom entry). This violates the intended behavior that after renaming a default category, it should not be added again as a custom category, leading to duplicate categories in `getAllCategories`.

The UI requirements R10‑R13 (ensuring FABs and Snackbar do not overlay Recent activity, proper scrolling, and bottom tab visibility on a 390x844 screen) are not verified in the current code. The current `DashboardScreen`, `BottomActionBar`, and related components have not been inspected, and there is no evidence they have been updated to meet these layout constraints.
feedback: Fix `syncCategoriesWithReceipts` to exclude categories that have been renamed from the default list, preventing duplicate entries. Update the Dashboard UI (BottomActionBar, Recent activity list padding, Snackbar positioning) and adjust the Bottom Tab layout to satisfy R10‑R13. Ensure all UI components render correctly on a 390x844 screen without clipping.
